label: GitHub Directory
description: A directory that holds Markdown files the GitHub connector syncs from a repository, as a collection of those files. Read only: GitHub is the source, and a change made in Marfa is put back on the next run. It is a child of its parent directory where that is synced too.

repository.description: The repository's full name, as owner/name.

path.description: The directory's path in the repository, from its root.

url.description: The directory's address on GitHub, on the default branch.

private.description: Whether the repository this row is in is private on GitHub, as of the last read: a row marked private holds what is not public, and its contents are not to be copied into a public place.
